Organization.definition: An organized body such as an institution, association, or government entity.

EducationalInstitution.definition: An organization that provides education, such as a school or university.

SportsTeam.definition: An organized group of athletes competing together.

MilitaryBranch.definition: A branch or division of armed forces (e.g. army, navy, air force).

Location.definition: A geographic place or spatial area.

AdministrativeTerritory.definition: A region defined by administrative boundaries.

Continent.definition: One of the principal large continuous land masses of the Earth.

BodyOfWater.definition: A significant accumulation of water such as a lake, sea, or ocean.

TerrainFeature.definition: A natural physical feature of the land surface.

TransportHub.definition: A transportation facility such as an airport, station, or port.

TransportLine.definition: A transportation route or transit line.

MediaWork.definition: A film, television, or media production.

Award.definition: A prize or recognition granted for achievement.

Event.definition: Something that happens at a given time and place.

Conflict.definition: An armed conflict, war, or battle.

Entity.definition: A generic entity used when the domain or range is open or heterogeneous.
